summary: Apache Parquet has just released the 1.18.2 RC2 version, following the RC1 and RC0 releases earlier in the week.  Community discussions this week focused on codec performance, with PFOR emerging as the fastest and most compressed option, and on schema evolution topics such as adding a FINITE_VECTOR type and clarifying the FILE logical type’s inline versus URI semantics.

highlights.text: Apache Parquet 1.18.2 RC2 released with a full changelog
Benchmarking FastLanes shows PFOR outperforms other codecs in decode speed and compression
